name: Aminata Diallo
action: Aminata politely declines to help with the cooking day before the ceremony, saying she must use Sunday to study for her Monday accounting exam.
reason: Fatoumata’s request activates Aminata’s sense of family duty, but her established pattern is to protect study time and avoid commitments that threaten her exam preparation and savings plan. The immediate memory of past family loss also pushes her away from treating goodwill as something that can be relied on without consequences, so she responds by preserving the scheduled study day rather than agreeing to the extra obligation.
